source: sars-guide:SARS ETI page, "Employment Tax Incentive (ETI)" (table from 1 April 2025; "grossed up to 160 hours ... grossed down in the same ratio"), fetched 2026-11-08; ETI Act s4(1)(b)(ii) as amended from 1 April 2025; National Minimum Wage R28.79 an ordinary hour from 1 March 2025 (gov.za media statement 5 Feb 2025)
notes: June 2025, employee aged 24 in month 4, 160 ordinary hours, R4 606.40 = 160 x R28.79: exactly the national minimum wage, so the employee qualifies and ETI is the flat R1 500 (R2 500-R5 499.99 band). The calculator gives the same today (no minimum-wage test), so this passes; it is the upper edge of the pair with eti-min-wage-1c-below-4606-39 and guards ET against a "<=" mutation. UIF 46.06, SDL 46.06, net 4 560.34. The floor is the employer's applicable minimum (a wage regulating measure, else the National Minimum Wage); the NMW R28.79 is assumed here because no sectoral measure is recorded. ET must compare in whole cents (4 606.40 vs 4 606.39), not in floating-point rand.
